Round 32 claim C1 (operability, capability acquisition) closes two runner items deferred since round 30: the `--regression` tally had no per-leg presence check, and the runner's own tally selftest left eight real mutants alive (round-30 seat MutateHead, `.ufo/waves/round-30/wC/MutateHead.md`).
